note: Public, unclassified sources only. Each link was opened and checked on 2026-10-26. Do not add links to DWAN/intranet, course material, restricted or classified documents.

manobs.title: MANOBS: Manual of Surface Weather Observation Standards
manobs.note: Official Canadian standards for surface observations, METAR and SPECI. 8th edition, Amendment 3. Free PDF.

manair.title: MANAIR: Manual of Standards and Procedures for Aviation Weather Forecasts
manair.note: Official TAF and aviation forecast standards. Viewable online; the page says contact ECCC for other formats.

nc-aws.title: Aviation Weather Services Guide
nc-aws.note: Plain-language guide to METAR, TAF, GFA, charts, radar and satellite. Revised May 2017, so some details may be dated.

tc-aim-met.title: TC AIM, MET chapter (Meteorology)
tc-aim-met.note: Canadian aviation weather services, PIREPs, AIRMET and SIGMET. Edition dated 1 Oct 2026. Large PDF (about 7 MB).

eccc-alerts.title: Criteria for public weather alerts
eccc-alerts.note: ECCC states this page has been updated and the older criteria replaced by weather Impact Guides. Check it for current alert rules; lesson numbers may be outdated.

eccc-hurricane.title: Hurricane forecasts and facts
eccc-hurricane.note: Current storm tracking, forecast product guides and season summaries.

eccc-beaufort.title: Beaufort wind scale table
eccc-beaufort.note: Force 0 to 12 with km/h, knots and sea and land effects.

eccc-marine.title: Understanding marine weather forecasts
eccc-marine.note: Index of marine forecast guides and decode tables (MAFOR, NAVTEX, lightstation reports).

eccc-marine-atl.title: Atlantic Canada regional marine guide
eccc-marine-atl.note: Winds, tides, currents and local weather effects around the Atlantic provinces.

eccc-marine-nat.title: Met 101: National marine weather guide
eccc-marine-nat.note: Basic meteorology for mariners: wind, sea state, fog, ice and hazardous weather.

eccc-radar.title: About Canadian weather radar
eccc-radar.note: How the Canadian radar network works, including the move to dual-polarization S-band radars.

project-atm.title: Project Atmosphere Canada: Teacher's Guide
project-atm.note: 15 free modules: clouds, pressure systems, jet stream, Coriolis, radar, satellites. Written for teachers, so basic level.

wmo-ca.title: International Cloud Atlas
wmo-ca.note: The official reference for cloud classification, with definitions and photos.

jet.title: JetStream: Online School for Weather
jet.note: Free self-paced weather school. US examples, but the physics is the same. Sections: atmosphere, clouds, upper air, synoptic, satellites, Doppler radar, thunderstorms, tropical.

jet-global.title: JetStream: Global Weather
jet-global.note: Uneven solar heating and the global circulation.

jet-clouds.title: JetStream: Clouds
jet-clouds.note: How clouds form and what they do and do not tell you.

jet-upper.title: JetStream: Upper Air
jet-upper.note: Why upper-air charts matter and how 500 mb charts are used.

meted.title: MetEd course catalog
meted.note: Free self-paced forecasting, aviation, satellite and NWP courses. Search the catalog for your topic (for example the aviation and satellite water vapour courses).
